issues.issue: Initial tan-filled tray, gold block and gray scoop could resemble a food tray at small sizes.
issues.resolution: Changed the block to blue with a large contrasting circle motif, enlarged the rose ring and recolored the scoop rose. Reprojected the authoritative scene and inspected final six views, five current cards and ten runtime variants. Size changed from 5,412/1,652 raw/gzip6 to 6,035/1,794; modest growth preserves a clearer play cue.

limitations: A shallow tactile tray with a ring, marked toy block and scoop. At 16 px its objects become colored marks, and a label distinguishes sensory play from other trays. Objects, filler, inventory, age suitability and developmental outcomes are not promised.
